1575:     def _get_indexcache_topk_indices(self, num_tokens: int) -> torch.Tensor:
1576:         if self.topk_indices_buffer is None:
1577:             raise RuntimeError("IndexCache requires topk_indices_buffer when skip_topk is enabled.")
1578:         topk_indices = self.topk_indices_buffer[:num_tokens]

1583:     def _update_indexcache_topk_indices(self, topk_indices: torch.Tensor) -> None:
1584:         if self.topk_indices_buffer is None:
1585:             return
1586:         num_tokens = topk_indices.shape[0]
1587:         topk_tokens = topk_indices.shape[-1]
1588:         topk_indices_to_cache = topk_indices
1589:         topk_indices_buffer = self.topk_indices_buffer[:num_tokens, :topk_tokens]
1590:         if topk_indices_to_cache.dim() == 3 and topk_indices_buffer.dim() == 2:
1591:             assert topk_indices_to_cache.shape[1] == 1
1592:             topk_indices_to_cache = topk_indices_to_cache.squeeze(1)
1593:         topk_indices_buffer.copy_(topk_indices_to_cache)
